question: Does the unchanged class-agnostic objects proposal, target-minus-sibling DINOv2 memory and native SAM2 refinement chain localize new physical door 13 at IoU at least 0.5 in all three frozen query views?

predecessor.single_change: Move the sealed full pipeline unchanged from consumed C16 to pre-RGB/pre-model frozen physical family 422885ce -> 1c211554, target door 13 and sibling door 59.

proposal.selection: Full-frame class-agnostic GroundingDINO proposals, descending objectness with deterministic coordinate ties and no query truth access.

descriptor.feature: Separately normalized exact-box and 1.5x-context DINOv2 CLS concatenation.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to the three target memories minus cosine to the one frozen sibling memory; coefficients +1/-1, no fitted scale or threshold.

masker.contract: Apply one native SAM2 mask to the unchanged contrastive top-one box, multimask false, zero mask threshold, no morphology or IoU-score selection, then take its tight bbox.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider target boxes enter only post-ranking proposal opportunity and post-SAM IoU evaluation.

decision_gate.interpretation: All three frames must contain a retained IoU-at-least-0.5 proposal and all three unchanged contrastive top-one selections after native SAM2 refinement must reach IoU at least 0.5.

literature_motivation.use: Class-agnostic objects proposals, instance-template matching and SAM refinement.
Explicit distractor memory for long-term generic indoor instance disambiguation.

forbidden_after_freeze: change images, proposal prompt/threshold/cap, descriptor/crops, memory, contrastive formula, SAM settings or IoU gate
use provider query boxes to generate, filter, resize, merge, rank or prompt proposals
retry, replace a frame or add any post-outcome rescue on this family
claim_boundary: A pass can establish only narrow same-provider new-family confirmation that the sealed pipeline acquires and localizes one bound physical door from full query frames. Same-provider geometry selected the reference and sibling boxes. It cannot establish open-set absence, broad distractor coverage, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
